message.content: Based on the conversations, ThaneChambers is currently playing "Black Myth: Wukong." This was mentioned in a message he sent to LiHua on November 24th, stating, "I get that! I've been hooked on ""Black Myth: Wukong."" The visuals are stunning, and the story is super immersive." Additionally, LiHua expressed her enjoyment of the game, saying, "Yeah, ""Black Myth: Wukong"" is awesome! I love how the gameplay feels so dynamic. I can't wait to unlock more abilities."
